faqs.q: Sec. 102-275. - Duties and powers of the director.
faqs.a:
(a)
General.
The director is authorized and directed to implement, administer, and enforce the
               provisions of this article. The director has the authority to:
(1)
Implement and administer a cross-connection control program and may develop written
               rules and regulations outlining the processes and procedures for surveying property
               for the purpose of establishing the extent of protection required for the city's water
               system and for other aspects of the program;
(2)
Determine and implement a process to select a backflow prevention assembly or backflow
               prevention method to control a cross-connection;
(3)
Establish and administer an annual cross-connection inspection program and communications
               plan therefor;
(4)
Require access to the property of customers receiving water service to conduct a cross-connection
               control survey, and survey all service connections within the water distribution system
               to determine if the connection is a cross-connection;
(5)
Control all service connections within the water distribution system if the connection
               is a cross-connection;
(6)
In a case where a backflow prevention assembly required by this article is not installed,
               tested, or maintained as required under this article, or if a backflow prevention
               assembly has been removed or bypassed, or if an uncontrolled cross-connection exists
               on the customer's property, the director may:
(i)
Control the cross-connection;
(ii)
Remove the cross-connection;
(iii)
Order the customer with the uncontrolled cross connection to take all necessary actions
               to ensure the connection is controlled;
(iv)
Suspend water service to the cross-connection. If water service is suspended, it shall
               not be restored until the conditions or defects that caused the uncontrolled cross-connection
               are corrected. In this case, the director shall give notice to the customer of the
               director's action, as well as of any order or orders necessary to ensure the customer's
               cross-connection is brought into compliance with this article as soon as is reasonably
               practicable after the director takes action to protect the cross-connection;
(v)
Except in cases where the director has determined there is an acute risk to the public's
               health, safety, or welfare, the director may grant a one-time compliance extension
               of no more than an additional 14 days to a customer who has requested an extension
               under
section 102-276
(f) of this article; or
(vi)
Take any other action as authorized by this article.
(7)
Control any service connection within the water distribution system in lieu of a survey
               if the service connection is controlled with an air gap or reduced pressure zone backflow
               prevention assembly;
(8)
Inspect, test or require the testing of, or audit any backflow prevention assembly
               or backflow prevention method used to control a cross-connection at any time to ensure
               compliance with this chapter;
(9)
Create and administer a licensing program for technicians;
(10)
Establish and collect fees for the administration of the program. Any such fees shall
               be set in accordance with
sections 2-261
—
2-263
of this Code;
(11)
Maintain records of cross-connection surveys, and of the installation, testing, and
               repair of all backflow prevention assemblies installed for containment and containment
               by isolation purposes;
(12)
Render interpretations of this article and adopt policies and procedures in order
               to clarify the application of its provisions. Such interpretations, policies, and
               procedures shall be in compliance with the intent and purpose of this article, and
               shall not have the effect of waiving requirement specifically provided for in this
               article;
(13)
Discontinue service of water to any property if uncontrolled cross-connections exist
               on the property, if any defect is found in an installed backflow prevention method
               or assembly, if a backflow prevention assembly or method has been removed or bypassed
               or does not adequately protect public health, or otherwise in accordance with this
               article; and
(14)
Otherwise implement, administer, and enforce the provisions of this article.
(
Ord. No. 4829
, § 1, 12-5-2022)
